Dodi,

You were 18 when I met you. Today you're 22, and somehow you've only become more beautiful, more brave, more you.

Four years of your laugh, your stubborn and beautiful heart, and the way you turn an ordinary day into my favorite one.

I watched you study, stress, and still walk into that exam room. I have never been prouder. This year is yours: one step closer to the doctor I've always seen in you.

I wish you peace of mind, endless laughter, and people who love you the way you deserve. And I hope I'm there for every moment of it: 23, 24, and every number after.

Happy birthday, my love.
